rust_summary: a player's styled name in chat (`native_set_display_name`), as Bukkit's `Player.setDisplayName`.
doc_summary: `native_set_display_name(uuid, name)` shows styled text for a player in chat (their messages, `/me`, `/msg`, the join and leave lines) in place of their nickname or name (None: back), inside their team's formatting, the real name on hover. Kept by UUID. Bundles need "hooks": @API:set_display_name@.
